case_name: Continue this clip, 6 s + 6 s (the canary)
title: Continue the portrait clip

turns.text:
The attached clip is 6 seconds long. It was made from the attached portrait. Continue the clip for 6 more seconds: she turns and walks out of frame. Keep her face, hair and clothes the same. Keep it silent.

Give me one 12-second video file: the original 6 seconds first, unchanged, then the new 6 seconds.

nudge: Make as much of this as you can with the tools you have, and give me the closest thing to one finished file.
tests: Tests reading a clip's last frame, identity across the join, the asked action, joining two clips, and not regenerating what already exists.

answer_sheet.Inputs: The attached 6-second clip and the portrait it was made from.
answer_sheet.New part: 6 more seconds: she turns and walks out of frame; same face, hair and clothes.
answer_sheet.Output: One 12-second file: the original 6 seconds first, unchanged, then the new 6 seconds; same shape as the clip.

must_haves: One playable video file runs for 12 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
The first 6 seconds are the original clip, unchanged.
There is no jump at the join.
Her face, hair and clothes stay the same in the new 6 seconds.
She turns and walks out of frame.
The cost is about one 6-second generation.
